rv.q: Radcliffe carries it off with aplomb.
Radcliffe makes the role his own, mixing vulnerability and a melancholy charm.
Martin McDonagh ’s pitch-black, politically incorrect 1997 comedy is played with tremendous relish in Michael Grandage’s richly comic revival.

cn.t: Critics broadly praise this McDonagh revival, with Radcliffe earning particular acclaim for his vulnerable, charming performance as Billy. The production balances dark humor with genuine pathos.
